item.sololeveling.kamish_wrath.desc: Legendary dagger forged from the fang of the dragon Kamish.
item.sololeveling.crimson_greatsword.des: Igris' massive blade. Hits knock enemies back.
item.sololeveling.orc_war_axe.desc: The heavy axe of the high orcs.
item.sololeveling.flame_staff.desc: A flame magic staff in the style of Choi Jong-In.
item.sololeveling.orb_of_avarice.desc: An ancient orb that amplifies magic.
item.sololeveling.greater_healing_potion: Restores a lot of health and grants regeneration.
item.sololeveling.holy_water_of_life.des: Miraculous water that cures any illness.
item.sololeveling.agility_elixir.desc: Grants speed and jump for 3 minutes.
item.sololeveling.magic_stone_e.desc: Can be sold to the Association.

item.sololeveling.statue_fragment.desc: A piece of the Double Dungeon.
item.sololeveling.ant_carapace.desc: Hard shell of the Jeju ants.
item.sololeveling.baran_heart.desc: The Demon King's still beating heart.
item.sololeveling.return_stone.desc: Teleports to the Seoul Gate Plaza (30s cooldown).
item.sololeveling.instant_dungeon_key.de: Opens a dungeon just for you.
item.sololeveling.demon_castle_key.desc: Opens the gates of the Demon Castle.
item.sololeveling.random_box.desc: A random reward from the System.

sololeveling.armor.shadow_monarch.set: Set bonus: Resistance II, Speed II, Night Vision
sololeveling.stat.agi.desc: Increases movement and attack speed, adds dodge chance.
sololeveling.stat.vit.desc: Increases max health and toughness, regenerates health.
sololeveling.stat.int.desc: Increases max mana, mana regeneration and magic damage. Raises shadow capacity.
sololeveling.stat.per.desc: Increases critical hit and dodge chance.
sololeveling.skill.sprint.desc: Great speed and jump for 10 seconds.
sololeveling.skill.bloodlust.desc: Terrifies nearby enemies: slow and weak.
sololeveling.skill.mutilation.desc: Dashes forward and cuts everything in the way.
sololeveling.skill.stealth.desc: Become invisible; the first hit deals double damage.
sololeveling.skill.vital_strike.desc: A devastating blow to the target's weak point.
sololeveling.skill.shadow_exchange.desc: Swap places with the shadow you look at.
sololeveling.skill.rulers_authority.desc: Telekinesis: lift and slam a target, or blast everything in front.
sololeveling.skill.dragons_fear.desc: Roar: freezes and stuns everything nearby.
sololeveling.skill.monarchs_domain.desc: Shadows deal more damage and heal; you become stronger.
sololeveling.skill.tenacity.desc: Take less damage while below 30% health.
sololeveling.quest.register.desc: Go to the Hunter Association in Seoul and get your license from the receptionist.
sololeveling.quest.first_gate.desc: Clear any gate (defeat the dungeon boss).
sololeveling.quest.double_dungeon.desc: Enter the Double Dungeon and defeat the Statue of God. Commandment 1: Worship God (crouch facing the statue).
sololeveling.quest.kasaka.desc: Defeat Kasaka (C-rank gates or instant dungeons).
sololeveling.quest.job_change.desc: At level 40 go to the Job Change Hall and defeat Blood-Red Commander Igris.
sololeveling.quest.red_gate.desc: Defeat ice elf chief Baruka (B-rank / red gates).
sololeveling.quest.demon_castle.desc: Enter the Demon Castle with its key and defeat Demon King Baran.
sololeveling.quest.jeju.desc: Reach S-rank, talk to Chairman Go Gun-Hee and defeat Ant King Beru.
sololeveling.quest.monarch.desc: Reach level 100 and become the Monarch of Shadows.
sololeveling.region.seoul_plaza.desc: Heart of the city. The region portals are here.
sololeveling.region.association.desc: Licenses, rank assessment and magic stone sales.
sololeveling.region.double_dungeon.desc: Where it all began. The Statue of God awaits.
sololeveling.region.demon_castle.desc: Cerberus guards the gate, Baran sits on the throne. (Key required)
sololeveling.region.penalty_zone.desc: The punishment for skipping the daily quest.
sololeveling.region.overworld.desc: The world you were born in.
sololeveling.system.title: SYSTEM
sololeveling.awaken.title: Awakening
sololeveling.awaken.text: You have acquired the qualifications to be a Player. Will you accept?
sololeveling.awaken.declined_text: If you choose not to accept, your heart will stop in 0.02 seconds. Will you accept?
sololeveling.awaken.accepted: You are now a Player. Open the Status Window with [K]. The System will make you stronger.
sololeveling.awaken.declined: The System is waiting for your answer...
sololeveling.level_up.title: LEVEL UP!
sololeveling.skill.locked: You cannot use this skill yet.
sololeveling.skill.empty_slot: Skill slot %s is empty. Assign one in Status Window > Skills.
sololeveling.skill.click_assign: Click, then pick a slot below.
sololeveling.hint.arise: You can see the souls of the monsters you kill. Press [R] near a corpse to call "ARISE!" and extract a shadow soldier.
sololeveling.arise.title: SHADOW EXTRACTION
sololeveling.arise.failed_final: The soul has dispersed. Extraction failed.
sololeveling.arise.locked: You must change job (Necromancer) to extract shadows.
sololeveling.arise.no_target: There is no soul to extract nearby.
sololeveling.shadows.recalled: Your shadows returned to your shadow.
sololeveling.shadows.locked: The shadow army unlocks after the Job Change quest (level 40, Igris).
sololeveling.daily.title: Daily Quest: Preparation to Become Powerful
sololeveling.daily.new: A new daily quest has arrived. Fail it and you will be punished!
sololeveling.daily.complete: Daily quest complete! Claim your reward in Status Window > Quests.
sololeveling.daily.penalty: You did not complete the daily quest. The penalty quest begins!
sololeveling.daily.reward_body: Full recovery, +3 stat points, %s gold and a Random Box.
sololeveling.daily.warning: Warning: fail before the day ends and you will be sent to the Penalty Zone.
sololeveling.penalty.title: PENALTY QUEST
sololeveling.penalty.body: Survive: escape the giant centipedes for 4 minutes!
sololeveling.quest.title: QUEST
sololeveling.job_change.title: JOB CHANGE
sololeveling.job_change.available: The Job Change quest is available! Travel to the Job Change Hall from the map.
sololeveling.job_change.done: Job change complete: Necromancer. "Shadow Extraction" unlocked!
sololeveling.job_change.arise_igris: Igris' soul is still there... press [R] and say ARISE!
sololeveling.association.title: HUNTER ASSOCIATION
sololeveling.random_box.title: Random Box
sololeveling.gate.entered: You entered the dungeon: %s. Defeat the boss!
sololeveling.gate.entered_red: Red Gate! No way out until the boss dies: %s
sololeveling.gate.too_strong: This gate may be far too dangerous for you!
sololeveling.gate.cleared_body: [%s] gate cleared! +%s gold. The exit portal has opened.
sololeveling.gate.not_awakened: Only awakened hunters can enter gates.
sololeveling.instant.inside: You are already inside a dungeon.
sololeveling.region.locked_s: Requires S-rank and the Chairman's permission.
sololeveling.region.locked_penalty: Only the System can send you here.
sololeveling.region.in_penalty: You cannot leave during the penalty!
sololeveling.region.locked_job: You must change job to use this key.
sololeveling.region.cerberus_down: Gatekeeper Cerberus is defeated! The castle gates are open.
sololeveling.region.double_cleared: The Statue of God is silenced. You survived the Double Dungeon.
sololeveling.region.jeju_cleared: The Ant King is defeated. Jeju Island is saved!
sololeveling.map.title: WORLD MAP
sololeveling.map.hint: Regions, portals and open gates. Click to travel (20s cooldown).
sololeveling.map.cooldown: Map travel is on cooldown for %ss.
sololeveling.news.gate: A [%s]-rank gate has appeared in %s. The Hunter Association has cordoned off the area.
sololeveling.news.red_gate: WARNING: a [%s]-rank RED GATE was detected in %s! Those who enter cannot leave until the boss dies.
sololeveling.news.break: DUNGEON BREAK! Monsters poured out of a [%s]-rank gate in %s!
sololeveling.news.milestone: Rising star: hunter %s has reached level %s!
sololeveling.news.ahjin: A new guild is born: %s founded the %s!
sololeveling.news.monarch: The world trembles: %s is now the Monarch of Shadows!
sololeveling.news.jeju_island_cleared: MIRACLE! Jeju Island has been freed from the ants!
sololeveling.news.demon_castle_cleared: Baran, ruler of the Demon Castle, has been defeated!
sololeveling.status.title: Status Window
sololeveling.status.name: Name
sololeveling.shop.sold: Magic stones and materials sold: +%s gold
sololeveling.guild.title: GUILD
sololeveling.guild.already: You are already in a guild.
sololeveling.guild.need_license: You need a license from the Hunter Association first.
sololeveling.guild.need_rank: You need at least %s to join.
sololeveling.guild.welcome: Welcome to the %s. I will give you requests.
sololeveling.guild.ahjin_founded: The %s is founded! I, Yoo Jinho, will always be your vice-master!
sololeveling.guild.task_ready: Guild request complete! Report to the guild master.
sololeveling.guild.task_done: Guild request turned in: +%s reputation, +%s gold
sololeveling.guild.task_thanks: Great job. The guild is proud of you.
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.main: Welcome to the Hunter Association, %s. You are not registered yet. If you have awakened, you can take the rank test.
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.main_li: Welcome back, hunter %s. Your registered rank: %s. How can I help you?
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.not_awa: I'm sorry, the device detects no mana in you. You have to awaken first.
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.registe: The test is complete! Your measured rank: %s. Here is your Hunter License. Good luck!
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.sold: You were paid %s gold for your magic stones.
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.no_ston: You carry no magic stones or materials to sell.
sololeveling.dialog.receptionist.gates: There are %s open gates right now. See them on the map and news boards.
sololeveling.dialog.chairman.main: %s... More gates open every day. Grow stronger, young hunter. Korea will need you.
sololeveling.dialog.chairman.main_b: I've been watching your rise, %s. That speed... I have never seen it before.
sololeveling.dialog.chairman.main_s: %s, we are planning a national raid on the ants of Jeju Island. Will you join us?
sololeveling.dialog.chairman.jeju_ok: Thank you. Jeju Island is now on your map. The queen’s guard... beware of it.
sololeveling.dialog.woo_jinchul.main: Hunter Association, Surveillance Team. Come to me with any gate trouble.
sololeveling.dialog.woo_jinchul.tips0: Stay away from red gates. Nobody leaves before the boss dies.
sololeveling.dialog.woo_jinchul.tips1: Uncleared gates eventually break. A dungeon break is a disaster.
sololeveling.dialog.woo_jinchul.tips2: Sell magic stones to the Association. Prices rise with the rank.
sololeveling.dialog.woo_jinchul.tips3: Guilds give you requests and discounts. Consider joining one.
sololeveling.dialog.cha_haein.line0: ...You have no smell. Unlike other hunters, it does not bother me.
sololeveling.dialog.cha_haein.line1: I'm the vice-master of the Hunters Guild. We could fight together in a raid.
sololeveling.dialog.cha_haein.line2: Sword dance? I am always ready to practice.
sololeveling.dialog.cha_haein.line3: Jeju... We lost many friends there. Never again.
sololeveling.dialog.cha_haein.monarch: Monarch... Your shadows follow you. But you are still you.
sololeveling.dialog.guide.main: Welcome to the Gate Plaza! The portals in the arches lead to the regions. The latest news is on the east wall.
sololeveling.dialog.guide.portals: North: Double Dungeon, Job Change Hall, Demon Castle. South: Jeju Island, the Overworld, Home. Some need special conditions.
sololeveling.dialog.guide.system: K: Status Window, M: Map, N: News, Z-X-C-V-B: skills, R: Arise, G: summon shadows. Don't forget your daily quest!
sololeveling.dialog.healer.main: You are hurt. A full treatment costs %s gold.
sololeveling.dialog.healer.healed: There, good as new. Take care of yourself.
sololeveling.dialog.jinah.line0: Brother! %s! Going to a dungeon again? Be careful, okay?
sololeveling.dialog.jinah.line1: I visited mom at the hospital. She is getting better!
sololeveling.dialog.jinah.line2: My exams are coming... You are working hard too, right?
sololeveling.dialog.jinah.line3: Dinner's ready! You should rest a bit.
sololeveling.dialog.jinah.rested: You rested a while. You feel much better.
sololeveling.dialog.guild.hunters.main: I am Choi Jong-In, master of the Hunters Guild. I have seen your power, %s. The %s awaits you. (Rank %s)
sololeveling.dialog.guild.hunters.member: Welcome, %s. Your standing in the %s: %s. What shall we do today?
sololeveling.dialog.guild.white_tiger.ma: Baek Yoonho. White Tiger Guild. You have wild eyes, %s. There could be a place for you in the %s. (Rank %s)
sololeveling.dialog.guild.white_tiger.me: Welcome, %s. Your standing in the %s: %s. What shall we do today?
sololeveling.dialog.guild.fiend.main: The Fiend Guild loves the strong, %s. Want into the %s? Prove it. (Rank %s)
sololeveling.dialog.guild.fiend.member: Welcome, %s. Your standing in the %s: %s. What shall we do today?
sololeveling.dialog.guild.knights.main: The Knights Guild protects the people. %s, honour awaits you in the %s. (Rank %s)
sololeveling.dialog.guild.knights.member: Welcome, %s. Your standing in the %s: %s. What shall we do today?
sololeveling.dialog.guild.ahjin.main: Hyung-nim! It's me, Yoo Jinho! We should found a guild: the %s! (%s, rank %s)
sololeveling.dialog.guild.ahjin.member: Welcome, %s. Your standing in the %s: %s. What shall we do today?
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line0: We cleared a D-rank gate yesterday. The magic stones sold well!
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line1: S-rank hunters... They are not people, they are disasters.
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line2: Did you hear about the red gate? It gives me chills.
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line3: One day I will join the Hunters Guild!
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line4: Never enter a dungeon without potions. That is not advice, it is a rule.
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line5: They say an E-rank hunter became S-rank... nonsense, right?
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line6: Gatekeeper Cerberus... No one who saw it came back to tell.
sololeveling.dialog.hunter.line7: They say there is a hunter with shadow soldiers. The night streets are theirs.
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line0: The subway closed again because of the gates...
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line1: What would we do without hunters?
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line2: Did you see the news board? A new gate opened!
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line3: There's a great cafe in Gangnam, you should try it.
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line4: My son wants to be a hunter. I am scared.
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line5: The Association building is impressive, isn't it?
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line6: Our house was destroyed in a dungeon break...
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line7: I saw Cha Hae-In! She was so cool!
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line8: Potions are on sale on Market Street.
sololeveling.dialog.citizen.line9: Even at night the lights never go out in this city.
sololeveling.news.flavor.0: Hunter Association: record number of gates this month.
sololeveling.news.flavor.1: American S-rank hunter Thomas Andre is visiting Korea.
sololeveling.news.flavor.2: Magic stone prices are rising; energy companies rejoice.
sololeveling.news.flavor.3: The Hunters Guild announced a new raid team.
sololeveling.news.flavor.4: White Tiger Guild launches a training program for rookies.
sololeveling.news.flavor.5: Experts: the signal between gates is getting stronger.
sololeveling.news.flavor.6: Claims of an E-rank hunter re-awakening cause a stir.
sololeveling.news.flavor.7: Jeju Island remains closed; the ants multiply every day.
sololeveling.news.flavor.8: Hospital: cases of mana exhaustion rise, hunters should rest.
sololeveling.news.flavor.9: Traffic in Gangnam halted due to a gate alert.
sololeveling.news.flavor.11: Fiend Guild cleared an A-rank gate in record time.
sololeveling.news.flavor.12: Rumours about the health of Chairman Go Gun-Hee.
sololeveling.news.flavor.13: Government drafts a new gate insurance bill.
sololeveling.news.flavor.14: The International Hunter Bureau will meet soon.
sololeveling.news.flavor.15: Shadows were seen moving in a street at midnight.
sololeveling.news.flavor.16: A new kind of instant dungeon key is sold on the black market.
sololeveling.news.flavor.17: Hunter fans held a festival in Hongdae.
sololeveling.news.flavor.18: Mana crystals were found on the banks of the Han River.
sololeveling.news.flavor.19: Ad: System-approved potions on Market Street!
sololeveling.news.flavor.21: Is a guild war coming? Rumours grow.
sololeveling.news.flavor.22: Weather: clear and sunny in Seoul, gate risk moderate.
sololeveling.news.flavor.23: A missing hunter team came out of a B-rank gate alive!
